data.name: Puerto Rico Racing: La Fiebre
data.detailed_description:
La Fiebre: Puerto Rico is an open-world racing game inspired by real Puerto Rican car culture.

Build your car and race through locations inspired by the island, from mountain towns to street meet spots.

This isn’t just about going fast. It’s about the vibe.

FEATURES

Open World Driving
Explore towns and mountain roads inspired by Puerto Rico
Cruise solo or join online sessions
Day and night atmosphere

Realistic Drag Racing
Functional drag tree
Reaction time and 60ft tracking
Quarter mile timing

Deep Car Customization
Engine swaps and performance upgrades
Suspension tuning
Tire and wheel fitment adjustments
Visual customization options

Online & Solo Play
Singleplayer free roam
Online multiplayer sessions
Competitive drag racing

DEVELOPMENT
La Fiebre: Puerto Rico is in active development.
Features, vehicles, and map expansions will continue to grow over time.

Wishlist to follow the journey.

data.short_description: An open-world racing game inspired by Puerto Rican car culture. Customize your ride, explore island-inspired locations, and compete in realistic drag races and street events with functional timing systems and online multiplayer.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 / AMD RX 6600 XT or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4080 / AMD RX 7600 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended
